description: Change the human's own profile: the name, emoji avatar, colour and timezone other people see. Only the fields you send change. Sending an emoji makes it their picture and deletes an uploaded photo. Their email address and sign-in methods are not editable here. Answers with the profile, as get_profile.

color.description: Hex colour behind the emoji, e.g. "#34c759".

emoji.description: One emoji to wear as the picture.

name: update_profile

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.
